lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: counting unit squares in standard square units
lessonRef.title: Guided practice A: counting unit squares in standard square units

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use this example as the model for the guided set below.

items.prompt: A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 4 rows of 5 squares each. How many unit squares cover it?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching adult. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 6 rows of 2 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?
A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 6 rows of 6 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?
A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 4 rows of 3 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?
A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 6 rows of 4 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?
A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 4 rows of 5 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 4 rows of 4 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?
A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 8 rows of 4 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 5 rows of 6 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?
A rectangle is covered by unit squares in 5 rows of 2 squares each, with no gaps or overlaps. How many unit squares cover the rectangle?
